C0366.title: CAUDIT: Mitigating SSH Brute-Force Attacks Through Continuous Auditing
C0366.summary: A USENIX NSDI '19 paper introduced CAUDIT, a system deployed on NCSA's production network to continuously audit SSH servers and mitigate brute-force attacks. It uses a /16 honeypot to collect attack metadata, replays attack attempts to identify vulnerable hosts, and combines this with black-hole routing to block malicious sources; over 463 days, it blocked an average of 57 million SSH attempts per day, a roughly 66-fold reduction from the daily average.

references.title: {CAUDIT}: Continuous auditing of {SSH} servers to mitigate {Brute-Force} attacks
